title: AWS Imagine Grant
description: Propose a cloud or AI project for your nonprofit to win up to USD 200,000 in unrestricted funding plus AWS credits. For registered 501(c) nonprofit organizations.
descriptionDetailed: The AWS Imagine Grant funds US and equivalent nonprofits using cloud technology to accelerate their missions. It runs once a year in two rounds, with awards across three tiers: Pathfinder (up to USD 200,000), Go Further, Faster (up to USD 150,000), and Momentum to Modernize (up to USD 50,000), each paired with AWS promotional credit. Winning organizations also get implementation guidance, AWS training, and marketing support.

prize.description: Pathfinder offers up to USD 200,000 in unrestricted financial support plus up to USD 100,000 in AWS Promotional Credit; Go Further, Faster offers up to USD 150,000 plus up to USD 100,000 in credit; Momentum to Modernize offers up to USD 50,000 plus up to USD 20,000 in credit. Winners also receive implementation guidance and AWS training.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Eligible organizations are US nonprofits with active 501(c) status, including 501(c)(3) charities, credit unions, and public utilities, as well as registered equivalents in the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Educational institutions are excluded. Round Two is extended by invitation only.
